description: Construction of a two storey extension with classrooms, staffroom, hall, resource room and toilet. The demolition of and the construction of new corridors and freestanding glazed canopies to provide covered play teaching areas.
decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted (5009/101/A, 102, 103, 104, 204/A and Design and Access Statement, Tree Report received 24/11/2010, Sustainability Statement received 13/12/2010, Travel Plan received 30/03/2011 and 5009/201/D, 202/F, 203/F and 205/B received 24/03/2011 and email and simulation results received 08/04/2011) therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.

Condition : 3 - In this condition "retained tree" means an existing tree which is to be retained in accordance with the approved plans and particulars; and paragraphs (a) and (b) below shall have effect until the expiration of (5 years?) from (the date of the occupation of the building for its permitted use).

(a)	No retained tree shall be cut down, uprooted or destroyed, nor shall any retained tree be topped or lopped other than in accordance with the approved plans and particulars, without the written approval of the local planning authority.  Any topping or lopping approved shall be carried out in accordance with British Standard[3998 (Tree Work)] or any other BS replacing.

(b)	If any retained tree is removed, uprooted or destroyed or dies, another tree shall be planted at the same place and that tree shall be of such size and species, and shall be planted at such time, as may be specified in writing by the local planning authority.

(c)	The erection of fencing for the protection of any retained tree shall be undertaken in accordance with the approved plans and particulars before any equipment, machinery or materials are brought on to the site for the purposes of the development, and shall be maintained until all equipment, machinery and surplus materials have been removed from the site.  Nothing shall be stored or placed in any area fenced in accordance with this condition and the ground levels within those areas shall not be altered, nor shall any excavation be made, without the written consent of the local planning authority.

Condition : 4 - The access doorways to the school buildings shall have a minimum clear width of 900mm, a level surface or ramp between the pavement and the floor and a door handle of not more than 1m above ground level.

Condition : 5 - The heating/cooling system described in the email and supporting simulation results shall be fully installed and operational before the occupation of the building unless otherwise agreed in writing beforehand by the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 6 - The extensions hereby approved shall not be occupied until details have been submitted to and approved in writing that show the type, quantity and location of cycle storage at the site that would seek to meet the objectives of annex 4 (parking standards) of the London Plan. These details shall be implemented as approved and permanently retained unless otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority.
